newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Italian senator to head U.N. Vienna office.
newsitem.headline: Italian senator to head U.N. Vienna office.

text.p: Italian senator Pino Arlacchi, an authority on organised crime, is to take charge of the U.N.'s Vienna office and the U.N. drug control programme, beginning in September, a U.N. spokesman said on Friday.
Arlacchi, who will have the rank of under-secretary-general, will succeed Giorgio Giacomelli who has held both posts since 1991.

As a senior adviser to the ministry of the interior, Arlacchi was responsible for a project that led to the creation of the Italian police corps dedicated to the investigation of transnational organised crime.
He was elected to the Chamber of Deputies in 1994, as a representative of Florence, and to the Senate in 1996.
He is currently honorary president of the Giovanni Falcone Foundation, named after a prominent prosecutor and friend who was assassinated by the Mafia in 1992.
